why: Issue #226's acceptance criterion: 'starting a replacement campaign requires confirmation only when an active run would be lost'. Without the gate the tertiary 'Start New Campaign' deletes the run on one click, from a button sitting directly under the Continue that describes it -- the single most destructive thing the Main Menu can do, and silent from every other angle, since the run store write happens inside the session the click creates.
